brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Build has 5 hex bases (3 on level 0, 2 on level 1) forming a compact L-shaped desk unit ~3 cells footprint. A notch drawer frame (notch:0#-1,1#notch0, hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) is installed in the notch between piece:0,0,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full, providing a pull-out drawer compartment on level 0. The frame is present but no separate drawer insert was offered by find_sockets; functionality is as drawer frame only.

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 installed at junction of piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full (three bases). Platform accessory requested (platform-sm and platform-lrg) was refused with TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED - this spike cannot carry a platform per configurator rules. Spike is present but small platform not attached.

finish.summary: Compact L desk of 5 bases with notch drawer frame installed and mount spike at the three-base junction. Drawer frame provides drawer bay but configurator offers no separate drawer insert; spike placed but platform rejected by rules as incompatible.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
